profile.fiximizer.smoothness.description: Stable frame times: reduce background contention with the game
profile.fiximizer.low_latency.descriptio: Serve important tasks sooner with a strict queue and conservative GPU offload
profile.fiximizer.balanced.description: Balance frame pacing, background throughput and resource use
profile.fiximizer.max_performance.descri: More parallel background work and a more permissive GPU policy
profile.fiximizer.memory_saver.descripti: Small task queue and one worker; OpenCL offload is disabled
screen.fiximizer.memory_override: Automatic memory saver active: heap is at %s%%. Memory Saver temporarily overrides your selection.
screen.fiximizer.performance_intro: Choose Fiximizer's behavior. Profiles tune only Fiximizer-managed background work; they do not reprioritize Minecraft or other mods' internal threads.
screen.fiximizer.memory_guard_help: Automatic switch when heap stays above %s%%. Return after usage remains below %s%% for several samples.
screen.fiximizer.integrations_intro: Fiximizer checks the loaded ModContainer and version for each target. An integration stays gated when its mod is absent or its toggle is off. This release provides detection and guarded extension points; specific Create/Sable patches are still under development.
screen.fiximizer.integrations_detection_: Mod detection is disabled in settings.
screen.fiximizer.jvm_intro: The recommendation uses physical RAM and the loaded mod count. It only sets Xms/Xmx; Java 21's default garbage collector is left unchanged.
screen.fiximizer.jvm_restart_note: To apply these arguments, paste the first line into Prism Launcher → Edit Instance → Java → JVM arguments, then restart the game. A running JVM cannot change Xms/Xmx.

screen.fiximizer.memory.title: Memory optimizer
screen.fiximizer.memory.intro: Bounded, opt-in sharing of explicitly submitted immutable metadata. The cache is created only after first use; no heap scan, global object rewrite or recurring task is performed.
screen.fiximizer.memory.scope: Only explicitly submitted immutable strings are considered. A hit reuses a different equal String instance; zero hits means no savings were observed.
screen.fiximizer.memory.g1_note: G1 dedup is JVM-wide, requires G1 and a restart, and may add GC CPU work. It is off by default.
